page.overview:
Who is Avincia Torres?

Avincia Torres is a Brazilian intelligence operative. The character appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage.

Avincia's unorthodox manner may put off some people, but once she embarks on a task, it is done with skill and precision. A master of disguises, Avincia is as likely to be found dressed as a candy striper, as in a military uniform. Notable for being dyslexic, she has skills in deception, hand-to-hand combat and invention, and is multi-lingual, speaking Portugese, English and Spanish. The character offers a reduced clothing cost, with a +10% critical chance using a steel club and +2% total offence using chain and blade. She is an "uncommon agent" (green) and can be levelled to level 15.
